outcome.Summary: Implemented a hand-written `Parse(args []string) (Config, error)` in cli/cli.go (no `flag` package). It handles `-v`/`--verbose` (repeatable, short-clusterable via `-vv`), `-n`/`-n=`/`-n5`/`--count`/`--count=` with integer ≥0 validation (default 1), `-o`/`--output` (default "-"), repeatable `--tag` appended in order (nil if none), `--` as the positional end marker, lone `-` as positional, and order-preserving positionals. Every error wraps `ErrUsage` via `%w` and names the offending flag. I verified the full rule set with a temporary test (all cases incl. missing/non-integer/negative count, unknown flags, and `--` semantics), then removed it; `gofmt`, `go vet`, and `go test ./... -count=1` all pass.
